accessibility.info:
Accessible seating is available for wheelchairs and companions, as well as limited mobility and sight/hearing impaired.  There is a 4 ticket limit for all accessible seating, unless otherwise posted.  Wheelchair and limited mobility patrons should purchase 1 wheelchair seat as their seat and up to 3 companion seats.  Wheelchair and limited mobility companions should also purchase wheelchair seats as their seat.  Sight/Hearing impaired patrons should purchase 1 sight/hearing impaired seat as their seat and up to 3 companion seats.  Sight/Hearing impaired companions should also purchase sight/hearing seats as their seat.  

Please Note:  Sight/Hearing impaired patrons should contact the box office after tickets are purchased to ensure additional accommodations are in place (interpreters and ALDs).  Box office can be reached by phone at 502-690-9090 during regular business hours.

Accessible seats are located in Sections 105, 109, 110, 307, 308, 311, 313 and 315 of the arena.

events.name: Jack's Lantern Trail
events.info: Your ticket time is when all guests for that time slot begin entering the Iroquois Amphitheater. Please allow an additional 30 to 45 minutes to reach the trail entrance. The trail opens at dusk, typically at 7:30 PM at the beginning of the season, but as early as 6:50 toward the end of the season, depending on daylight and weather. WALKING DISTANCE = From the Amphitheater entrance to the trail entrance is a 1/3 of a mile. The trail is an additional 1/3 of a mile, and you can enjoy it at your own pace. On average, completing the trail takes 35-45 minutes. Final entry to the Amphitheater is 10:00 PM Sunday through Thursday and 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday. All guests inside the Amphitheater by that time will be allowed onto the trail.
events.pleaseNote: Journey through an enchanted forest where magic awaits around every bend. Marvel at thousands of intricately carved jack-o'-lanterns and immerse yourself in an adventure that delights guests of every age. Your ticket time indicates when the line for that time slot will begin entering the Amphitheater. We will open the trail at dusk, which is the best time to enjoy the glow. The opening time for the trail varies depending on weather and daylight hours as the month progresses. From the Amphitheater entrance to the trail entrance is 1/3 of a mile. The trail is an additional 1/3 of a mile, and you can enjoy it at your own pace. On average, completing the trail takes 35-45 minutes. Final entry to the Amphitheater is 10:00 PM Sunday through Thursday, and 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday. All guests inside the Amphitheater at closing will be allowed through the trail. Free parking is available on-site.

events.info: Your ticket time is when all guests for that time slot begin entering the Iroquois Amphitheater. Please allow an additional 30 to 45 minutes to reach the trail entrance. The trail opens at dusk, typically at 7:30 PM at the beginning of the season, but as early as 6:50 toward the end of the season, depending on daylight and weather. WALKING DISTANCE = From the Amphitheater entrance to the trail entrance is a 1/3 of a mile. The trail is an additional 1/3 of a mile, and you can enjoy it at your own pace. On average, completing the trail takes 35-45 minutes. Final entry to the Amphitheater is 10:00 PM Sunday through Thursday and 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday. All guests inside the Amphitheater by that time will be allowed onto the trail.

Accessible seating is available for wheelchairs and companions, as well as limited mobility and sight/hearing impaired.  There is a 4 ticket limit for all accessible seating, unless otherwise posted.  Wheelchair and limited mobility patrons should purchase 1 wheelchair seat as their seat and up to 3 companion seats.  Wheelchair and limited mobility companions should also purchase wheelchair seats as their seat.  Sight/Hearing impaired patrons should purchase 1 sight/hearing impaired seat as their seat and up to 3 companion seats.  Sight/Hearing impaired companions should also purchase sight/hearing seats as their seat.  

Please Note:  Sight/Hearing impaired patrons should contact the box office after tickets are purchased to ensure additional accommodations are in place (interpreters and ALDs).  Box office can be reached by phone at 502-690-9090 during regular business hours.

Accessible seats are located in Sections 105, 109, 110, 307, 308, 311, 313 and 315 of the arena.
